scope: Exact planar footprints and exported routes, not GPU triangles, photographic fidelity, roof details or survey certification. Boundary-only contact is permitted.

publishedBaseComparison.presentationEntries: Photograph-informed entry fractions updated on six pavilions; entity.accesses and commercial geometry are retained.

actualRenderedFloors.source: Current derivePavement(PARK_RENDER_ENTITIES) asphaltCells/walkCells and deriveParkDetails concrete; distinct from pre-protection A2 envelopes in park-technical.json roads.

currentConnectivity.coverageCheck: Analytic boundary intervals on centre and both lateral paths; no fixed sampling step may skip a floor gap.
currentConnectivity.method: Conservative scanline union grid, eroded one cell, four neighbours; every emitted path analytically partitioned at exact floor/obstacle edge intersections on its centre and both lateral clearance paths. No rendered geometry is generated by the audit.
currentConnectivity.condition: Exact GEOS line-to-centre distance minus radius for every segment, including both lateral paths. These exported paths come from the current offline grid and exact floor-boundary validation; this review does not invent an extra connection or assert operational clearance.
